answer: No. Your dad can sign power of attorney form NW-POA-2, which can be signed electronically and doesn't need a notary. The notary rule applies only in Georgia, not Virginia. NW-POA-2 replaced the older notarized NW-POA-1 on February 1, 2026, and an NW-POA-1 is no longer accepted after June 30, 2026, so make sure he uses NW-POA-2. Bring the signed form, your own photo ID and the car's documents.
